name: "Furyoki" The Note of the Prisoner
source: Volume 2 of SUZUNE's Digital Novel Series is a visual novel with gameplay elements. There are two possible endings, and the ending changes depending on the mini-games played during the main story.
translation: Volume 2 of SUZUNE's Digital Novel Series is a visual novel with gameplay elements. There are two possible endings, and the ending changes depending on the mini-games played during the main story.
